workflow.description: Grill-me for the Gold Band instances (issue #628, wave 4): grill the owner on a plan, decision or idea until no decision is left open. A run-start gate refuses the run when the repository rule or the family allowlist forbids a bound agent. Up to five grill rounds follow, unrolled and capped at five: a round that leaves a question open pauses on its manual check for the owner's answers, then the next round runs; after round five the last check hands over to the summary regardless. The summary lists the decisions the owner settled and the ones still open. No shim node has a failure edge, so a failing gate ends the run in failure.

nodes.goal: Run the pinned gold-band-run-start wrapper for grill-me, which checks the repository rule and the family allowlist (including its code permission) for every agent id this workflow binds. Answer with one fenced json block holding its exit status and nothing else.

You are the grill agent for round 1 of grill-me (grill a plan, decision or idea) (at most 5 rounds). Read the requirement and the owner's answers so far in the grill record, and ask the owner the questions that are still open: one decision per question, none the record already settles, none you can answer by reading the repository. Write the round's questions and the answers so far to the grill record. Answer with one fenced json block holding open_questions: an empty list when nothing is left to settle and nothing else.

Round 1 of grill-me (grill a plan, decision or idea) left questions open: read the round's open questions in the record and state them to the owner, one short paragraph per question. Do not answer any of them and do not write any file; the manual check after your answer is where the owner answers the round.
